jobs.description:
Dear all,
 



  





 Vertex Elite is currently seeking a qualified
 **· SAP BRIM Technical Consultant** 
 to join our team.
 



  





 If you or someone in your network might be a fit, please feel free to reach out for more details or share an updated resume.
 



  





**Job Type : Contract/Fulltime** 




**Location: Bangalore, Karnataka** 




  





**Required Qualifications** 




 SAP BRIM Technical Consultant \- (3–6 years).
 



 Develop and support SAP BRIM (Billing and Revenue Innovation Management) for our client's subscription and usage\-based billing.
 



  





 Key responsibilities:
 



 \- Build ABAP developments across Subscription Order Management (SOM), Convergent Charging (SAP CC), Convergent Invoicing (CI) and FI\-CA.
 



 \- Implement FI\-CA / CI events, BAdIs and enhancements; handle billable items (BITs) and consumption items.
 



 \- Build interfaces to and from BRIM components and external systems.

 Good to have:
 



 \- Convergent Mediation, Revenue Accounting (RAR), subscription billing domain.
 



  





**With Best Regards,** 




**Lakshmi

**SAP BRIM SOM Consultant**


**Enterprise Performance**


Our Enterprise Performance team helps clients unlock value from enterprise platforms and digital technologies across finance, supply chain, manufacturing, and IT operations. As an SAP BRIM SOM Functional Consultant, you will support the configuration, implementation, and maintenance of SAP BRIM solutions.


The ideal candidate should be able to collaborate with business stakeholders, architects, and technical teams to deliver end\-to\-end subscription lifecycle management processes, ensuring seamless integration with SAP Billing and Revenue Innovation Management (BRIM), CRM, S/4HANA, and related systems.


In this role, you will work with business and technology teams to translate requirements into SAP BRIM CM solutions, support process improvement, and contribute to large\-scale transformation programs. You will bring functional knowledge, configuration experience, and a delivery\-focused approach to help clients improve operational efficiency and achieve sustainable business outcomes.


**Level**: Consultant or equivalent


As an experienced Consultant at Deloitte Consulting Services, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Need\-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements.


**Work you'll do**


As a Consultant, Functional Transformation on the Enterprise Performance team, you will be responsible for:


* Analyze business requirements and translate them into SAP SOM functional and technical solutions.
* Design, configure, and implement SAP Subscription Order Management (SOM) processes.
* Support end\-to\-end subscription lifecycle management, including order capture, fulfilment, change management, renewals, and cancellations.
* Integrate SAP SOM with SAP BRIM components such as:
	+ SAP Convergent Charging (CC)
	+ SAP Convergent Invoicing (CI)
	+ SAP Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable (FI\-CA)
	+ Convergent Mediation (CM)
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including CI, CM, and FICA consultants.
* Able to understand End to End business flow and interaction of SAP with Non – SAP systems.
* Prepare technical and functional documentation.

**The team**


Enterprise Performance


Our Enterprise Performance team is at the forefront of enterprise package insights and platform technology, working across finance, supply chain, manufacturing, and IT operations to support delivery of holistic performance improvement and package led large scale digital transformation. Join our team of strategic advisors and architects, differentiated by our industry depth to help collaborate and leverage your experience in strategy, process design, technology enablement, and operational services to enable the heart of business insights and collaborate with the businesses as they navigate their enterprise growth and transformation journeys.


The Enterprise Operations Portfolio is a suite of offerings designed to help clients maximize value from their Finance, Supply Chain, and IT operations. By taking a holistic approach—from strategy development to process design and technology enablement—we support clients in overcoming operational challenges and managing key business functions. As organizations pursue digital transformation, these areas become vital in shaping interactions with customers, suppliers, and stakeholders. By integrating strategy, operational improvement, implementation, and managed services, we creatively deploy resources and drive innovation, ensuring clients achieve impactful, sustainable results at the speed demanded by today’s dynamic market.


**Location:** Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Pune / Chennai


**Shift Timings:** 24\*7 rotational shifts including night shifts as per business requirements


**Qualifications**


**Required**:


* 3\-5 years of hands\-on experience in SAP BRIM with a focus on SAP SOM.
* Strong understanding of master data and governance, BTMF process and ODI Infrastructure
* Knowledge of SAP BRIM components such as CC, CI, CM, and FICA.
* Experience with integrations, APIs, XML/JSON, and web services.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Business knowledge of Integration suit like BTP, AI tools are good to have knowledge.
* Knowledge on business tools like Visio, PowerPoint, Notepad\+\+.

**Preferred**:


* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, IT, or related field.
* SAP BRIM training/certification is an advantage.
* Experience in Telecom, Subscription, or Usage\-Based Billing domains is preferred.

jobs.title: SAP IS-U Billing Functional Lead
jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**
================

 **Location: USA: Remote (Must be willing to work PST hours)**

  

Concentrix is looking for a highly experienced SAP IS\-U Billing Functional Lead to lead the design, configuration, testing, implementation, and support of SAP IS\-U Billing and Invoicing solutions for utility clients. This role requires deep functional expertise in utility billing processes, strong integration knowledge across SAP IS\-U modules, and the ability to drive complex billing transformation initiatives from requirements gathering through post\-production support.




The successful candidate will serve as the primary Billing SME, collaborating with business stakeholders, system integrators, technical teams, and project leadership to deliver innovative and compliant billing solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **SAP IS\-U Billing \& Invoicing**

* Lead the design, configuration, enhancement, and support of SAP IS\-U Billing and Invoicing solutions.
* Configure and maintain billing schemas, rate categories, operands, tariff structures, pricing configurations, and billing master data.
* Design and support invoice and bill print functionality, including customer\-facing billing outputs.
* Configure and maintain utility rate structures and pricing models aligned with business and regulatory requirements.
* Analyze and resolve complex billing exceptions, billing failures, invoicing errors, and outsort processing issues.
  

  

### **Time\-of\-Use (TOU), EDM \& Advanced Billing**

* Design and configure Time\-of\-Use (TOU) rates and billing scenarios.
* Support Energy Data Management (EDM) functionality, including interval data processing, profiles, and usage calculations.
* Implement and support advanced billing programs such as:
	+ Net Metering
	+ Aggregate Billing
	+ Renewable Energy Programs
	+ Distributed Energy Resources (DER)
	+ Emerging Utility Products and Services

  

### **Device Management Integration**

* Ensure accurate integration between Device Management and Billing processes.
* Support meter\-related processes including:
	+ Meter Reads
	+ AMI/Smart Meter Data
	+ Device Installations
	+ Device Removals
	+ Device Replacements
	+ Register Management
* Troubleshoot billing issues related to estimation, meter reading validations, implausible reads, and rate determination.
  

  

### **FICA Integration \& Meter\-to\-Cash**

* Manage billing integration with SAP FICA to ensure accurate invoice posting and financial processing.
* Support contract accounts, account determination, budget billing, dunning, collections, and payment processing.
* Partner with FICA teams to resolve:
	+ Posting Errors
	+ Reconciliation Issues
	+ Account Determination Problems
	+ Billing\-to\-Finance Integration Defects
* Validate and support the complete Meter\-to\-Cash lifecycle.
  

  

### **Functional Leadership**

* Lead business requirements and solution design workshops.
* Translate business requirements into functional designs and system solutions.
* Develop detailed RICEFW functional specifications.
* Collaborate with ABAP development teams throughout design, development, testing, and deployment activities.
* Provide leadership and mentoring to junior consultants and billing team members.
* Serve as the primary functional lead for the Billing workstream.
  

  

### **Testing, Deployment \& Production Support**

* Support System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and defect resolution.
* Validate end\-to\-end integrations across Billing, Device Management, EDM, and FICA.
* Participate in deployment planning, cutover activities, hypercare support, and production issue resolution.
* Ensure solution quality, scalability, and compliance with utility business requirements.
  

  

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

  

* Bachelor’s degree in information systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
* 10\+ years of SAP IS\-U Billing \& Invoicing functional experience.
* Strong hands\-on configuration experience in:
	+ Billing Schemas
	+ Rate Structures
	+ Tariff Structures
	+ Billing Master Data
	+ Price Management
	+ Bill Print Configuration
* Experience with:
	+ Time\-of\-Use (TOU) Billing
	+ Energy Data Management (EDM)
	+ Net Metering
	+ Aggregate Billing
	+ Utility Billing Transformations
* Deep understanding of SAP IS\-U Device Management integration.
* Strong knowledge of SAP FICA integration and financial posting processes.
* Experience supporting the end\-to\-end Meter\-to\-Cash process.
* Ability to write detailed RICEFW functional specifications.
* Experience leading workshops and managing stakeholder relationships.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and leadership skills.
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

  

* Utility industry experience supporting electric and/or gas utilities.
* Experience working with Investor\-Owned Utilities (IOUs).
* Multiple full\-cycle SAP IS\-U implementation experience.
* Experience with AMI Smart Meter and Meter Data Management (MDM) integrations.
* Knowledge of SAP CRM, Front Office, and Customer Service integration.
* Experience with SAP BW reporting and analytics.
* Familiarity with OpenText Ex stream or other bill presentment solutions.
* Experience supporting SAP S/4HANA Utilities transformation programs.
* Knowledge of regulatory compliance, tariff filings, and utility rate changes.
* Experience implementing renewable energy and Distributed Energy Resource (DER) programs

Actual salaries will vary based on work location, qualifications, skills, education, experience, and competencies.
